name: International Business School, Budapest
description: IBS International Business School Budapest was founded in 1991 as Hungary's "First Private Business University". Together with its international education partner "The University of Buckingham", it has become a truly international business school with its English and Hungarian undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programs offered to students from all over the world. With the realization of Brexit, all IBS undergraduate and graduate programs are accredited in both the EU and UK.
